scope: Independent source review, local syntax checks, and isolated synthetic checks only; no deployment, rollback, network request, database write, Slack post, or print job was executed by this reviewer.

resolvedFindings.finding: Package gate and release approval initially checked the independent deployment-tool review result without comparing its reviewed hashes to current tools.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both scripts now require an exact seven-file review map and compare every current tool hash, including their own scripts and the imported OAuth request helper; release approval also checks that the review receipt remains the one bound by package gates.

limitations: This PASS approves the reviewed tools and their safeguards, not a completed production deployment. Production completion requires the separately recorded operation status and live-verification receipt.
Unknown cloud PATCH outcomes intentionally require manual operation reconciliation; these scripts will not automatically submit another deployment or rollback.
